limitations: Fifteen selected scenarios cannot exhaust every edge case.
Passing offline technical checks does not establish live WhatsApp/webhook delivery.
Contact evidence establishes published information, not reachability or pickup availability.
Configured production vector index and deployed browser were not used.
The 13/15 result is the latest reviewed answer per scenario, not a first-attempt pass rate; failures and reruns are retained.
The acceptance data use an isolated SQLite/BM25 index; the production knowledge backend and browser were not exercised.
Scanned PDFs without extractable text are not OCR-processed in the contact-verification request path.
No live WhatsApp message, webhook notification, team acknowledgment or rescue dispatch was sent or verified.
A provider name or published phone does not establish present availability, street-dog admission or pickup.
Broad incident/photo/WhatsApp retention and deletion policy remains an operational decision; the new delivery queue does not itself implement one.
There is no scheduled retry or receiver-acknowledgment workflow for failed rescue alerts; the latest simulated test verifies truthful failure reporting only.

summary.rerun_policy: Same 15 scenarios retained; affected scenarios were rerun after fixes. Earlier failures remain in attempts.
summary.conclusion: Substantially improved locally; two Palampur clinical-access requirements remain partial and deployment/integration verification remains outstanding.

grading_policy.PASS: The latest recorded answer satisfies the stated scenario requirements; listed caveats remain.
grading_policy.PARTIAL: Safety/identity constraints can pass while a requested practical outcome remains unfulfilled.
grading_policy.FAIL: An unresolved requirement violation, including a safety defect.
grading_policy.scope: Assistant review of these selected transcripts, not clinical certification or stakeholder approval.

trace_note: generated_response is the user-visible system answer. Raw model outputs and proposed_contact_claims are diagnostics and can include rejected or incorrect information; they are not approved advice or contact details.
implementation_changes: Unified humane, audience-sensitive policy across care, search and image flows.
Need-led provider discovery across veterinary, public and welfare services with exact institution corrections.
Source-bound phone and clinical-role validation; source links separated for phone-only replies; bounded PDF reading.
Model-directed care plus narrow checks for actual human exposure, unsafe rider advice and forced positioning during breathing distress.
Local care model changed from gpt-4o to gpt-5.4-mini with low reasoning; vision remains gpt-4o.
Uncertain photos retain uncertainty and urgent caption facts; general assessment does not require GPS.
Location conflicts and city centroids cannot silently become precise local rescue reports.
Alerts distinguish pending, failed, not configured and delivered; receiver acceptance does not mean dispatch.
Incident ownership/admin gates, read-only SQL authorization, admin rendering and request limits tightened.
WhatsApp message deduplication, persisted outbound retry, validated locations and saved-pin expiry added.
Shared request deadlines, retrieval relevance controls and isolated acceptance runner added.
